experimental_design: two groups (control diet and Western diet) comparing healthy and obese rats using two proteomic approaches (2-DE and shotgun proteomics)
Thus, our study evaluated myocardial protein expression in healthy and obese rats, employing two proteomic approaches.
number_of_biological_replicates: Male Wistar rats were established in two groups (n = 13/group): control diet and Western diet fed for 41 weeks.
number_of_technical_replicates: the pool was analysed as three technical replicates.
technical_replicate: the pool was analysed as three technical replicates.
technology_type: Proteomics was based on two-dimensional gel electrophoresis (2-DE) along with mass spectrometry identification, and shotgun proteomics with label-free quantification.
